verdict.rationale: AgentMail has no native conversation assignment or rule-based routing. A team could approximate ownership by tagging threads with Labels and could build its own routing logic on webhook events. Lists only allow or block senders and domains, and the per-pod 'route webhook events' guidance is tenant plumbing rather than mail-routing rules. Missing for 10: native assignment of conversations to teammates, a rule engine for routing incoming mail, explicit owner fields or team-lead UI, and any hands-on corroboration.
